This creature does not maul victims.

SHE COMFORTS THEM INTO DROWNING.

Thin grief-filaments emerge sparingly from the Hollow and the mourning garden: wet veil fibers, black root threads, pearl-like strands. They can later wrap around victims and siphon memory, but do not make her a tentacle monster.

Lower-body wardrobe:
heavy ruined mourning skirts and ceremonial fabric,
charcoal-black,
dirty ivory,
drowned teal,
dark brown,
rotted lace,
long wet funeral panels,
asymmetric train,
root fibers.

No conventional witch clothing.
No staff.
No horns.
No extra arms.

She should feel ancient, powerful, grotesque, maternal, emotionally predatory, and completely unforgettable.

A creature whose embrace feels safer than escaping.
